#summary Features of ECP or Why should I use ECP?

The EMF Client Platform provides a standard one-click solution for EMF-based applications.  including the following features:
  * Tree-based Navigator
  * Form-based Editor
  * Validation View
  * Worspace for persistency, versioning and repository connection
All components are customizable and replaceable. Therefore ECP provides a good starting point for the development of EMF-based applications.
